build_vision_transformer_model: build a VisionTransformer model from a configuration for image classification tasks
create_attention_module: create a multi-head attention module with configurable heads, qkv bias, and dropout
extract_intermediate_features: extract intermediate feature representations from specified ViT blocks by name
run_vision_transformer_forward: run a forward pass on a VisionTransformer model with optional masked image modeling
build_fully_sharded_vit: build a VisionTransformer with FSDP wrapping for distributed training
